title: Grant @Admin user in-game admin privileges

requirements.text: Update backend admin-role assignment so that the user whose in-game username is exactly "@Admin" (after trimming leading/trailing spaces) is granted the admin role in the access control system when they save their profile (both on initial profile creation and on subsequent profile updates).

quotes: make @Admin in the game an admin

acceptanceCriteria: When a user saves a profile with username "@Admin" (ignoring leading/trailing spaces), subsequent calls to the backend admin-check APIs (e.g., isCallerAdmin / getCallerUserRole) indicate the caller is an admin.
The role assignment happens during saveCallerUserProfile so it works even if the @Admin profile already exists (user can re-save the profile to receive admin role).

requirements.text: Fix backend logic so that saving a new user profile does not automatically grant admin privileges to every new user; admin auto-grant should only apply to the intended bootstrap policy (first 5 profiles) and the special "@Admin" username.

quotes: make @Admin in the game an admin

acceptanceCriteria: Creating a new profile with a username other than "@Admin" does not grant admin role unless the profile is within the initial bootstrap policy (first 5 profiles).
Creating new profiles beyond the bootstrap policy (after the first 5) does not grant admin role unless the username is "@Admin".

constraints: Backend must remain a single Motoko actor in backend/main.mo; do not introduce additional backend services.
Do not edit frontend immutable paths listed in SYSTEM_CONTEXT.
nonGoals: Adding new UI for granting admin by username.
Changing how Internet Identity authentication works.
Implementing new admin features beyond ensuring @Admin has admin role.
